provenance: The printed output of the last cell of notebooks/colab_gpu_diagnose.ipynb, run by the repository owner on a free Colab Tesla T4 (the run date and commit were not recorded in the output), pasted in unchanged except that leading shell output is dropped. It compares rung 1 (A) with rung 3 (B) on 500,000 photons of the benchmark tissue (configs/bench/tissue_g09.mci), 50 batches, using every Nsight Compute counter (1,375 collected for each). Nsight Compute locks the GPU clocks while profiling, so only ratios and percentages are comparable with the benchmark's kernel times. The saved .ncu.csv files from that session were not committed.
